g.text: B Secondary frozen full-q family (225 policies)
Hill of Towie 2025, 5 frozen instances, 365 shared days, 1,059,248 valid intervals. Three-day block bounds.
Panels use different joint families; their UCBs differ. Secondary q.925 was not the primary historical choice.
Both policies use a common upstream forecast trained on wind/power. No field-safety or universal-minimum claim.
